findings: The prior callback-exception propagation failure is repaired: both PRE and POST callbacks are wrapped, every exception is recorded in a local failure latch, stored through PhysxManager.store_callback_exception(), re-raised, and callback_failure_count is included in overall_pass.

The probe uses the pinned native PRE_PHYSICS_STEP and POST_PHYSICS_STEP APIs, requires exact per-step PRE/POST ordering and cardinality, checks callback state freshness against immediate external reads, and verifies deregistration across reset.

Contact measurements use native PhysX tensor data with copied buffers, explicit scalar normal-force/impulse-magnitude semantics, finite thresholds, correct N and N*s units, and a force-to-impulse timestep consistency check.
The source parses successfully and the inspected pinned PhysxManager and contact-sensor snapshots match their indexed SHA-256 hashes.
The plan truthfully limits this program to API/component discovery and does not claim frozen-contract qualification or physical success before native execution.
